mapper.select: select i.*, d.rental_days, h.rental_hours from invoice i left outer join invoice_daily d on i.id = d.invoice_id left outer join invoice_hourly h on i.id = h.invoice_id order by created_at desc limit #{page.offset}, #{page.pageSize}

select i.* from invoice i where i.id like '%${p}%' or i.customer_name like '%${p}%' or i.room_id like '%${p}%' or i.billed_date like '%${p}%' order by created_at desc limit #{page.offset}, #{page.pageSize}
select count(1) from invoice where id like '%${p}%' or customer_name like '%${p}%' or room_id like '%${p}%' or billed_date like '%${p}%'

select i.*, it.name_type, d.rental_days, h.rental_hours from invoice i left outer join invoice_daily d on i.id = d.invoice_id left outer join invoice_hourly h on i.id = h.invoice_id join invoice_type it on i.invoice_type = it.code where i.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into invoice(id, invoice_type, room_id, price, customer_name, billed_date) values(#{id}, #{invoiceType.code}, #{roomId}, #{price}, #{customerName}, #{billedDate})
mapper.update: update Invoice set room_id = #{roomId}, price = #{price}, customer_name = #{customerName}, billed_date = #{billedDate}, invoice_type = #{invoiceType.code} where id = #{id}
